spec.description: One entry per species (sw d1e198a, user 15 Oct) against the same engine with it off, on two forts as built at embark: the small savage lake (V75_SMALLSAV, straddles 3 region tiles: the case the TR2 measurement says matters most) and the good coast (V75_GOOD, 1 site tile, 6 draw tiles). Spring to the end of autumn, one replicate per arm. Expect with it on: no species with more than one open surface entry; walkers' share of land waves up and fliers' and DF-multi-stocked species' (kakapo on 6 tiles, ravens) down; cast coverage up on the ground; in-cast odds then follow FREQUENCY alone (the ladder's spread stays: fix 2, on hold).
spec.needs: sw-wt/plugin d1e198a scripts deployed; V75_SMALLSAV, V75_GOOD .preverify
